name: Physics3D
description: Rigid bodies in C: dynamic, kinematic and static spheres, boxes and capsules with sequential impulses, friction, restitution, warm starting and island sleeping, ball/hinge/distance/weld joints, colliding with each other and with the static triangles of a Collision3D world; bodies drive Scene3D nodes and each world steps in its own Loop system with fixed 1/60 s substeps.
